translation:
If after a long time it ulcerates and breaks open and the qi and blood are deficient, one should use Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯); if after ulceration cold evil congeals and it does not close, one should use the Fermented Soybean Cake (豆豉餅) to dispel and scatter it. In this condition, if one does not supplement qi and blood, does not take care in daily living, does not restrain the seven emotions, or uses cold and cooling attacking and reducing methods, it all belongs to the incurable. <ins>Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯)</ins>
Bupleurum (柴胡, two qian), scutellaria (黃芩, one and a half qian), pinellia (半夏, processed), ginseng (人參, each one qian), licorice (甘草, honey-fried, five fen)
With the guiding herb two slices of ginger (姜), decoct in water and take.
